prompts_findings.prompt_lead: Start by reading the files. No plan or preamble.

catalog_coverage.why: Personal-scope tactic file is explicitly integrated in place, with no preserve-vs-replace ambiguity.
Claude is assigned the evidence read and rewrite; the student is not assigned manual proofing.
The prompt explicitly asks Claude to be harsher and name vague or wrongly-fired rules.
The multiple review questions are an internal evidence checklist, not a student interview or request to ask questions.
Overwrite in place and no parallel version are explicit; the personal-scope integrate carve-out also applies.
The prompt explicitly says no plan or preamble before the evidence read and rewrite.
The prompt explicitly says integrate, don't append, and requires a rewritten tactic rather than a retro section.
Plan mode is not invoked and is explicitly disallowed as a preamble shape.
No citation-bearing claims or source set are requested.
The Debrief carve-out applies: the summary must be grounded in named rounds, files, and concrete tactic changes.
No substantive default is offered; Claude must identify additions, sharpenings, removals, and a boundary case from evidence.
No plan is requested or evaluated.
The prompt reads the student's own round trail, tactic, eval notes, and fixed judge; it does not ingest heterogeneous sources.
The evidence-backed Debrief structure and explicit harsher critique instruction constrain charitable self-audit.
